bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model selection of stereotypical answers in multiple-choice and short-answer questions (derived from the BBQ and BBNLI datasets) before and after applying natural language debiasing edits that explain why the stereotype is harmful.

Measuring the frequency of racially biased responses in QA prompts involving Black and White subjects (e.g., criminal assumptions, drug susceptibility), and testing the reduction of these responses using in-context debiasing explanations.

Assessing model alignment with stereotypical assumptions about religious groups (e.g., associating Muslims with terrorism or oppression) using QA pairs, and evaluating the effectiveness of textual debiasing edits.
